hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that integrates with Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it deposits input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another, enforcing a proprietary bonding curve invariant (CurveLib). Uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fully handle swap execution and accounting internally, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity.
